fc.title: Festive cut-off
fc.sub: Tell customers the last day to order for delivery before a festival. Before that time the shop says "Order by …"; after it, it says the order arrives after the festival.
fc.note: The dates and the words live in the festive Smart Rule (template "Festival delivery cut-off"). This page decides where the shop shows them. No price, offer, charge or payment changes.
fc.offBody: Turn it on in the settings card at the bottom of this page.
fc.offAsk: Ask the owner to turn it on.

rules.empty: No festive rule is switched on. Make one in Smart Rules from the template "Festival delivery cut-off", type the last order time for each delivery band, and switch it on.
rules.nothing: Nothing — the rule has no words for this yet.

card.d: Festive cut-off banners. Off as it ships.
card.readOnly: You can see these settings but not change them.
card.on: Show festive cut-offs on the shop
card.onHelp: On: the switched-on festive rules speak on the places ticked below. Off: the shop never shows them, and checkout keeps its usual delivery promise.
card.linkHrefHelp: A page on your shop, for example /collections/eid. Shown on a computer only. Empty: no link.

err.STALE: Someone changed this meanwhile. Reload the page.
err.forbidden: You don't have permission for this.
